gloss: to scheme; to plot; to plan (something devious)

definitions.gloss: to scheme; to plot; to plan (something devious)
definitions.explanation: To secretly plan something, usually with malicious or self-serving intent.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}かたくらんでいるに{違|ちが}いない。
{彼|かれ}らは{会社|かいしゃ}の{乗|の}っ{取|と}りをたくらんでいた。
examples.english: They were scheming to take over the company.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

KANJI:
Can be written as {企|たくら}む.

CONJUGATION:
・たくらまない (negative)
・たくらんで (te-form)
・たくらんだ (past)

NUANCE:
Almost always used with negative connotations. For neutral or positive planning, use {計画|けいかく}する or {企|くわだ}てる.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{企|たくら}む - same word with kanji
・{企|くわだ}てる - to plan, attempt (more neutral)
・{謀|はか}る - to plot, conspire (literary)
